title: At the electronics shop
instructions: Ali kulaklık almak istiyor. Seçenekleri, fiyatları ve kararını takip et.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Hi. I'm looking for some headphones for running.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We have these wireless ones for sixty pounds, or these with a cable for twenty-five.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Cables are annoying when I run. Are the wireless ones waterproof?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, they are. And the battery lasts eight hours.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Do you have them in white?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Only in black and red, I'm afraid.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Black is fine. Can I pay by phone?

questions.prompt: What does Ali want the headphones for?
questions.evidence: I'm looking for some headphones for running.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Ali want headphones with a cable?
options: Cables are annoying when he runs.
questions.evidence: Cables are annoying when I run.

questions.prompt: How long does the battery last?
